uniqueCompleteCover.reasonForE1: the pair blocker {D1,E1} plus known P0 ownership of D1 forces P1 ownership of E1
uniqueCompleteCover.reasonForA1: odd control of wing column A includes singleton blocker A1

interpretation: Within the five-wing column-phase family induced by the center D/E pairing topology, exactly one of 32 parity assignments statically blocks every geometric P0 win line.
That unique complete cover simultaneously requires P1 ownership of A1 and E1 while D1 is already P0-owned.

P1 can occupy at most one of A1/E1 before P0's second move, so P0 can occupy the other immediately. The unique static complete cover is therefore temporally unrealizable at the first response boundary.

This exactly predicts two known positive control edges: after P1 replies E1, P0 A1 is winning; after P1 replies A1, P0 E1 is winning. The W/D/L labels are validation only, not premises of the phase-cover enumeration.
claim_boundary: The result proves impossibility only for this generic phase/pairing safety family. It does not yet prove that every possible P1 safety policy after center opening belongs to this family.
